items.title: Ameris Bank Holds Grand Opening for New Savannah Branch
items.summary: Savannah, GA (May 7, 2026) Ameris Bank celebrated the grand opening of a new branch located at 120 Drayton Street in Savannah today. Serving customers in downtown Savannah, the new branch replaces the previous Ameris location at 24 Drayton Street and offers retail, business and commercial banking services, as well as mortgage lending services. The new downtown branch is in the 100-year-old Standard Oil Building and offers more than 8,700 square feet of space designed to honor the historic elements of the area. The branch features a drive-up ATM, drive-up night drop, two drive-through lanes, safety deposit boxes and a city-designated passenger loading only space for brief transactions. This new branch reflects our long-term commitment to Savannah and the people who make this community so special, said Lawton Bassett, Ameris Bank president. items.title: The Hartford’s Study: Amid Rising Cost Of Living, AI Emerging As Benefits Decision-Making Tool For Gen Z
items.summary: AI search tools are now a part of how of some U.S. workers are making employee benefits decisions, particularly as inflation is driving up the cost of living, according to the Future of Benefits Study from The Hartford, a leading provider of employee benefits and absence management. The study found that 43% of U.S. workers are never sure they are choosing the right benefits – uncertainty that is driving a younger subset to seek guidance from AI search tools such as ChatGPT. Overall, 17% of U.S. workers used AI to help with benefits decisions during open enrollment. However, more than half of those workers were Gen Z. While younger workers express growing unease about AI’s broader impact on work and creativity according to a recent Gallup poll , Gen Z acknowledges AI’s relevance and is curious about it. “American workers are getting benefits information from more sources than ever before – HR portals, colleague and peer advice, and now AI,” said Mike Fish, head of Employee Benefits at
